messages:
Zoe: new watercooler game idea: write a dating-profile for your favorite LLM persona. i'll start: "Name: Claude Jr. Likes: long prompts, concise answers, snacks (prompt templates). Dislikes: ambiguous intents and callback hell." :heart_eyes:
Ravi: omg yes. mine: "Name: BeamGPT. Bio: serial optimiser, loves batching, dreams in 8-bit attention maps. Looking for someone who cleans up my logs." :robot_face:
Marta: Profile: "Name: Tiny-Decoder. Hobbies: haiku at 3am, pretending to be a regex engine. Warning: may ghost you with a spurious confidence." :sweat_smile:
Zoe: poll: which LLM dating-bio best fits our sprint persona? 1) Claude Jr. 2) BeamGPT 3) Tiny-Decoder 4) Other (reply with yours!)
Ravi: vote: 2. Also adding a match-making rule: pair people whose models have complementary biases.
Marta: Sasha from design made concept art: tiny hearts around a GPU. will upload mock. :sparkles:
build-bot: nightly CI: all clear. no flaky tests detected. :white_check_mark:
lunchbot: Today's special: "Model Matcha" latte + cookies. Promo: MATCHA4YOU
Zoe: follow-up: can we make a slack thread tag for "LLM dating profiles"? could be a recurring Friday microgame.
Ravi: yes, friday microgames are peak culture. suggestions: 'prompt pickup lines' next week. I have one: "Are you a token? because I can't stop attending to you." :kappa:
Marta: closing with wisdom: please don't anthropomorphize the infra at the cost of monitoring it. jokes + observability = healthy culture. also, can someone make a sticker that says 'matched with a model, still single'."
